provenance.generator: scripts/generate_bundle_binding_vectors.py (deterministic; reuses the repo buyer/seller test seeds)
provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS over the artifact minus its hash-excluded fields (FaultAttestationBundle: signatures+anchoredByRole; binding: signature); attestation_bundle_hash = sha256 hex; signatures ed25519 over the CORE §B.7 domain-separated payload (dacs-fault-bundle:v1: / dacs-bundle-binding:v1: || hash), base64url-unpadded. Regenerated deterministically by scripts/generate_bundle_binding_vectors.py (--check is a byte-for-byte determinism proof).
provenance.note: candidate tier — awaiting a second-impl cross-run per CROSS-RUN.md. Regenerated by scripts/generate_bundle_binding_vectors.py: bundles reshaped to the FaultAttestationBundle type (the type's version discriminator replaces the legacy per-bundle version literal) and re-signed under dacs-fault-bundle:v1:; the §10.4.2 BB-6/BB-7 L2 model updates vectors 7–8 — vector 7 (the former equal-standing-void case) is renamed to bb-equal-standing-divergence (fail → indeterminate) and vector 8 bb-multiplicity-limit changed error → indeterminate, since equal-standing authorized divergence and budget exhaustion are indeterminate, never a void or a classification.
provenance.listingRef: Each vector's listingRef.contentHash is synthetic (sha256("listing-" + jobId)), not pinned to a real listing — the listing is not the subject of these resolution vectors.

gaps: cross-role-rebinding adversarial coverage requested in the round-2 review
decisionModel: Resolve a side's native bundle address through published BundleBindings. Order: BB-4 signature/signer verify; BB-5 reject-on-any over the signed tuple (bindingVersion supported, jobId/role == requested, logicalAddress == derive(signed jobId, role), fetched jobId == binding.jobId, byte-exact §10.4.1 attestation_bundle_hash, signer holds role, §10.4.1 faultedParty within the permissible set for (outcome, anchoredByRole)); group the BB-4-valid candidates by authenticated signer and prune to the co-signed party map where available; fetch at most N=8 in ascending bundleContentHash order; among authorized copies collapse canonically-equal, apply full-signature precedence, and treat equal-standing divergence as indeterminate (BB-6); BB-7 fail-closed. Dispositions: a resolved+valid binding to a present copy is present (pass); a present-but-invalid binding is fail; total non-resolution, budget exhaustion, or equal-standing authorized divergence is indeterminate; authoritative absent requires the CORE §5 absence-evidence policy.

vectors.name: bb-valid-resolution
vectors.note: Well-formed seller BundleBinding resolves to a matching FaultAttestationBundle completed bundle: BB-4 verifies, tuple/logicalAddress/jobId/contentHash all match, signer holds role.

want.reason: binding verifies (BB-4) and all BB-5 post-fetch checks pass; native address resolved

vectors.name: bb-invalid-binding-sig
vectors.note: The only published binding fails BB-4 (signature does not verify against signer's key) and is discarded; a present-but-invalid binding is a verified rejection.

want.reason: BB-4 signature verification fails; binding discarded, no valid resolution

vectors.name: bb-tuple-mismatch
vectors.note: A validly-signed binding whose logicalAddress matches (j, seller) but whose signed role is "buyer" contradicts the requested tuple (BB-5.4) and mis-derives its logicalAddress (BB-5.5).

want.reason: binding.role != requested role (BB-5.4); logicalAddress != derive(signed jobId, role) (BB-5.5)

vectors.name: bb-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: Binding verifies and resolves, but the fetched bundle's §10.4.1 attestation_bundle_hash != binding.bundleContentHash (BB-5.8), so the fetched bundle is rejected.

vectors.name: bb-cross-role-rebinding
vectors.note: Cross-role rebind of a single-signed abort: seller re-anchors under seller role keeping the hashed faultedParty=seller, so (outcome=aborted-by-other, anchoredByRole=seller) contradicts the §10.4.1 mapping (expected faultedParty=buyer). The copy is rejected; blame stays with the true aborter (seller).

want.reason: declared faultedParty is outside the §10.4.1 permissible set for (outcome=aborted-by-other, anchoredByRole=seller) — the permissible value is any party role other than seller (buyer here); the cross-role rebind is rejected (BB-5), so it cannot silently reverse blame

vectors.name: bb-missing-binding
vectors.note: No BB-4-valid binding resolves for the requested (jobId, role) — the only published binding is for a different logicalAddress. The side is not retrieved (BB-7); with nothing to verify the outcome is indeterminate, not a verified failure.

want.reason: no BB-4-valid binding resolves for the requested (jobId, role); the side's §10.4.3 read disposition is indeterminate — neither present nor authoritatively absent (BB-7)

vectors.name: bb-full-sig-precedence
vectors.note: Two canonically-unequal copies resolve for one (jobId, role): a co-signed completed copy and a later single-signed divergent abort. BB-6 full-signature precedence retains the co-signed copy and discards the lesser-signed divergent.

want.reason: BB-6 full-signature precedence among authorized copies: the co-signed completed copy is retained over the single-signed divergent; both copies are seller-authorized

vectors.name: bb-equal-standing-divergence
vectors.note: The seller publishes two equal-standing single-signed aborts that diverge on the absolute faultedParty (seller vs buyer). BB-6 voids the side (equal signature standing, never silent selection); the side is not retrieved (BB-7).

want.reason: two equal-standing single-signed authorized copies diverge on the absolute faultedParty (seller vs buyer); BB-6 selects neither and the side's read disposition is indeterminate (BB-7) — the session is excluded from reputation, not blamed; there is no void

vectors.name: bb-multiplicity-limit
vectors.note: Nine distinct BB-4-valid bindings resolve for one (jobId, role), exceeding the N=8 fetch bound. BB-6 caps the fetch and the side is treated as not retrieved (BB-7) fail-closed — an operational error, the verifier does not proceed.

want.reason: nine authorized bindings exceed the BB-6 fetch budget N=8; budget exhaustion yields the side disposition indeterminate, never a classification — a consumer MAY re-run resolution with a larger budget
